expectations.what: Skip link points at #main-content, which does not exist on the page.
expectations.note: axe's skip-link rule is best-practice and cites no criterion, so a broken bypass mechanism cannot gate the run. Worth knowing whether the report distinguishes that from a clean pass.

expectations.what: Water-main notice is amber (#e8c400) on white — 1.7:1.
Service tiles are divs with onclick handlers: no role, no href, no tabindex, unreachable by keyboard.
expectations.note: The whole primary navigation of the site. axe-core ships focus-order-semantics disabled, so nothing deterministic will say this.

expectations.what: Two-axis meetings table: th cells in both directions, no scope on any of them.
Five links reading "Download", each going to a different PDF.
expectations.note: axe returns this one undecided when it fires at all. Either outcome is informative: reported as needs-review is the human queue working; absent is a gap.

expectations.what: Council recording has no captions track.
Permit search box is named only by a title attribute — a tooltip no touch user sees.
expectations.note: axe accepts title as an accessible name, so the deterministic pass will call this clean.

expectations.what: Radio group has no fieldset or legend; the question "What are you applying for?" is a loose paragraph.
Visible label says "Email address"; aria-label overrides it to "Contact", so speech input cannot address it.
Page carries meta refresh at 30 seconds, with no way to turn it off.
"Full notice" link is aria-hidden but still in the tab order.
White text across a gradient that ends near-white; contrast varies along the box.
Property address field, correctly labelled and left alone.
